name: Village Pack
author: ct
description: Reusable pixel-art content for RPG maps: the 'village' tileset (grass, paths, water, trees with crowns for the front layer, houses, fences, chests, a forest floor and a cave mouth, things lying on the ground to pick up — brushwood, stones, a mushroom — with solid flags), charsets of a hero, an elder, a villager, a merchant, a slime and a wolf, battle portraits of the hero, the slime and the wolf, and two battle backgrounds (meadow, forest) with depth maps. Art only: no maps, no stories.
